inconsistencies: Compiler baseline chain: #36287 (Xcode CLT 26.3) and #36042 (g++ 13) are prerequisites for #36036 (clang 19) and ultimately #36033 (C++23 RFC). Review order should be #36287/#36042, then #36036, then the #36033 decision; they must stay in the same band since the later ones depend on the earlier ones.

#28690 adds dependency rules to check-deps.sh while #35167 rewrites check-deps.sh in Python and edits doc/design/libraries.md; they will conflict. Decide the check-deps direction (#35167) before or together with #28690.
#36147 (native BSD CI VMs replacing cross-compile jobs) may obsolete #35722 (caching BSD SDK downloads for the cross-compile base image). Review #36147 first; #35722 may become unnecessary.

#36082 (Guix builds in CI) and #35774 (native testing of cross-built macOS arm64 binaries) attack the same blind spot of untested release-like binaries. #36082 is the broader fix and should be reviewed first; #35774 is the cheaper incremental step.

#35197 (--icf=safe on darwin), #36193 (--disable-wchar_t for non-GUI Linux) and #36269 (_GLIBCXX_USE_DEPRECATED=0) are three independent release-binary size reductions by the same author; reviewing them as a group avoids repeated Guix reproducibility checks. #36269 has by far the smallest payoff.

Multiprocess/IPC build cluster: #35068 (depends CMake prefix path, affects native_libmultiprocess), #35454 (external libmultiprocess targets), #36060 (KJ exception check), #32387 (Windows IPC) and #19460 (wallet -ipcconnect, depends on #10102/#29409, unblocks #19461) all touch the same subsystem; #35068 and #35454 are the configure-time fixes and should go first.

#35911, #36167 and #36268 are all 'enable a compiler warning and fix the whole tree' PRs with overlapping touched files; they are deliberately banded differently (#36167 cites a real masked bug, #36268 is cosmetic), but they should be sequenced to avoid repeated tree-wide rebasing.

#36023 (always define HAVE_SYSTEM) and #33828 (gen-manpages checks HAVE_SYSTEM/ENABLE_WALLET/WITH_ZMQ in bitcoin-build-config.h) both depend on how optional macros appear in the generated config header, as does #35072 (removing optional defines from it). #35072 could break #33828's check and should be reviewed with it.
result.notes: Release integrity dominates the top of this category: the three P1s (#35765 wrong-source depends archives, #36425 broken codesign environment, #36293 revoked keys counting toward the verification quorum) all concern producing or verifying release binaries. The P2 band is split between release/CI coverage (#25573, #36082, #35774, #31507, #36340) and the coordinated compiler-baseline transition (#36287, #36042, #36036, #36033) plus the Boost.Test removal; the long P3 tail is mostly contributor friction and build hygiene, and P4 is reserved for diagnostics-only or cosmetic sweeps.
